_readme: Verse of the day. One verse per calendar day (Africa/Addis_Ababa), chosen by the date so every student sees the same verse. These Amharic verses are the ones QUOTED IN THE GRADE 10 TEXTBOOK, so they come from approved material, but a teacher must verify the wording and references against the Ethiopian Bible. To add more: append {reference, text_am, source}. Nothing is invented: only entries with text_am are shown.

verses.text_am: አንድ ጌታ አንድ ሃይማኖት አንዲት ጥምቀት
verses.source: 10ኛ ክፍል ትምህርተ ሃይማኖት textbook (quoted there) — teacher to verify against the Ethiopian Bible
